subject: Project updates
text: Hello, I wanted to share a small but encouraging update, because the result turned out better than I expected. The review came back faster than planned, and the main comments were far gentler than I had imagined. I revised the early section on Monday, submitted it with the extra appendix, and the response arrived by Thursday morning. It felt unusually smooth, and I did not have to rebuild the whole structure as I feared I would. The next stage now looks more manageable, although I still want to confirm the meeting notes before finalising anything. If you want the full message later, I can send it when it is convenient for you. I know you mentioned your own report may not be finished yet, so no need to reply right away. For now, I just did not want to keep such a small victory waiting in a folder. I hope your week has also had a few easy moments. Warmly
